bloques: STEAMbit blocks: sensors, outputs, motors and screens.
bloques.borrarMensajes: Clears the Morse message and the translated message.
bloques.boton: Returns 1 if the button is pressed and 0 if it is not.
bloques.guardarMensajeMorse: Starts reading the Morse button on P0: short = dot, long = dash.
bloques.helice: Turns the propeller on or off.
bloques.led: Turns the LED on or off.
bloques.ledIntensidad: Sets the LED brightness: 0 = off, 1023 = maximum.
bloques.mensajeMorse: The message written in dots and dashes.
bloques.motorMulticolor: Spins one motor. Use + to choose the speed (0 to 100).
bloques.movimientoCm: Moves forward or backward the chosen centimeters, then stops.
bloques.movimientoGirar: Turns the robot the chosen degrees, then stops.
bloques.movimientoSimple: Moves the robot at the chosen speed (0 to 100).
bloques.oledBorrar: Clears everything on the OLED screen.
bloques.oledEscribir: Writes text or a number on the OLED screen.
bloques.puertoToAnalogPin: Converts a port to its analog pin.
bloques.puertoToDigitalPin: Converts a port to its digital pin.
bloques.servo: Moves the servo to the chosen angle (0 to 180°).
bloques.tiraRgb: Sets the color of each of the 6 LEDs on the strip.
bloques.tiraRgbAjustada: Lights the whole strip with a mix of red, green and blue (0 to 255).
bloques.tiraRgbApagarTodos: Turns off all the LEDs on the strip.
bloques.traducirMensaje: Translates the Morse message into letters.
bloques.ultrasonido: Measures the distance to an object in centimeters (0 to 200).
